cards.ex: After prison, he promised to turn over a new leaf and become a better person.
cards.exUz: Qamoqdan keyin u yangi sahifa ochishga va yaxshiroq inson bo'lishga va'da berdi.
cards.uzDef: O'z xulq-atvorini yaxshilashga qaror qilmoq, yangi hayot boshlash.

cards.ex: I felt like my boss kept moving the goalposts on the project, so I could never succeed.
cards.exUz: Mening boshlig'im loyihada qoidalarni o'zgartirayotgandek tuyuldi, shuning uchun men hech qachon muvaffaqiyatga erisha olmadim.
cards.uzDef: Qoidalarni yoki talablarni o'zgartirish, maqsadga erishishni qiyinlashtirish.

cards.ex: The new law set in motion a series of changes in the education system.
cards.exUz: Yangi qonun ta'lim tizimida bir qator o'zgarishlarni harakatga keltirdi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani boshlash, jarayonni ishga tushirish.

cards.ex: It takes time to adapt to living in a different country.
cards.exUz: Boshqa davlatda yashashga moslashish uchun vaqt kerak.
cards.uzDef: Yangi vaziyatga yoki sharoitga ko'nikish, o'rganish.

cards.ex: The small village eventually evolved into a bustling city.
cards.exUz: Kichik qishloq oxir-oqibat gavjum shaharga aylandi.
cards.uzDef: Vaqt o'tishi bilan o'zgarish, yangi holatga o'tish.

cards.ex: This new technology is a big step forward in cancer research.
cards.exUz: Ushbu yangi texnologiya saraton kasalligini tadqiq qilishda katta qadamdir.
cards.uzDef: Yaxshilanishga yoki maqsadga erishishga qaratilgan harakat.

cards.ex: The internet has brought about a sea change in the way we communicate.
cards.exUz: Internet bizning muloqot usulimizda tub o'zgarishlar olib keldi.
cards.uzDef: Katta va sezilarli o'zgarish.

cards.ex: If you keep practicing, you'll get somewhere with your guitar playing.
cards.exUz: Agar siz mashq qilishni davom ettirsangiz, gitara chalishda nimagadir erishasiz.
cards.uzDef: Muvaffaqiyatga erishish, taraqqiyotga erishish.

cards.ex: The economy seems to be on the right track for recovery.
cards.exUz: Iqtisodiyot tiklanish uchun to'g'ri yo'lda ko'rinadi.
cards.uzDef: To'g'ri yo'nalishda harakat qilish, muvaffaqiyatga yaqinlashish.

cards.ex: We're finally starting to make headway on this difficult project.
cards.exUz: Nihoyat, biz ushbu qiyin loyihada oldinga siljishni boshladik.
cards.uzDef: Taraqqiyotga erishish, muvaffaqiyat sari siljish.

cards.ex: There's a steep learning curve when you start using this software.
cards.exUz: Ushbu dasturiy ta'minotdan foydalanishni boshlaganingizda, o'rganish jarayoni qiyin bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Yangi narsani o'rganish uchun kerak bo'ladigan vaqt va harakat.

cards.ex: Scientists have made a major breakthrough in AIDS research.
cards.exUz: Olimlar OITSni tadqiq qilishda katta kashfiyot qilishdi.
cards.uzDef: Katta muvaffaqiyat, muhim kashfiyot.

cards.ex: You've come a long way since you started learning English.
cards.exUz: Siz ingliz tilini o'rganishni boshlaganingizdan beri ancha yo'l bosdingiz.
cards.uzDef: Katta taraqqiyotga erishish, ancha yaxshilanish.

cards.ex: I need to get up to speed on the latest developments in the project.
cards.exUz: Men loyihaning so'nggi o'zgarishlari haqida xabardor bo'lishim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Yangi ma'lumotlar bilan tanishish, joriy vaziyatni bilish.

cards.ex: We have several new products in the pipeline for next year.
cards.exUz: Kelgusi yil uchun bizda bir nechta yangi mahsulotlar rejalashtirilgan.
cards.uzDef: Tayyorlanayotgan yoki rejalashtirilgan holatda bo'lish.

cards.ex: The new website is still a work in progress, but it's improving every day.
cards.exUz: Yangi veb-sayt hali ish jarayonida, lekin u har kuni yaxshilanmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Hali tugallanmagan, takomillashtirilayotgan narsa.

cards.ex: Sometimes you just have to let nature take its course.
cards.exUz: Ba'zida siz tabiatga o'z yo'liga qo'yib berishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaning tabiiy rivojlanishiga ruxsat berish.

cards.ex: The company is always ahead of the curve when it comes to technology.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya texnologiya masalasida har doim ilg'or.
cards.uzDef: Boshqalardan oldinda bo'lish, yangiliklardan xabardor bo'lish.

cards.ex: Let's get the ball rolling on this project by setting up a meeting.
cards.exUz: Keling, uchrashuv tashkil qilish orqali ushbu loyihani boshlaymiz.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani boshlash, harakatga keltirish.

cards.ex: The agreement sets the stage for future cooperation between the two countries.
cards.exUz: Ushbu kelishuv ikki davlat o'rtasidagi kelajakdagi hamkorlik uchun sharoit yaratadi.
cards.uzDef: Kelajakdagi voqealar uchun sharoit yaratish.

cards.ex: This new technology is a real game changer for the industry.
cards.exUz: Ushbu yangi texnologiya sanoat uchun haqiqiy o'yinni o'zgartiruvchi hisoblanadi.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatni tubdan o'zgartiradigan yangilik yoki voqea.

cards.ex: Learning a new language can open up opportunities for travel and work.
cards.exUz: Yangi tilni o'rganish sayohat va ish uchun imkoniyatlar ochishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Yangi imkoniyatlar yaratish, yangi yo'llarni ochish.

cards.ex: If you want to succeed, you need to get your act together and focus.
cards.exUz: Agar siz muvaffaqiyatga erishmoqchi bo'lsangiz, o'zingizni qo'lga olishingiz va diqqatni jamlashingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: O'zini tartibga solish, yaxshiroq harakat qilish.

cards.ex: The deal fell through, so we're back to square one.
cards.exUz: Kelishuv amalga oshmadi, shuning uchun biz boshiga qaytdik.
cards.uzDef: Boshlang'ich nuqtaga qaytish, yangidan boshlash.

cards.ex: The new manager is planning to shake things up to improve productivity.
cards.exUz: Yangi menejer mahsuldorlikni oshirish uchun vaziyatni o'zgartirishni rejalashtirmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Tartibni buzish, o'zgarishlar kiritish.

cards.ex: The artist is known for pushing the envelope with his experimental designs.
cards.exUz: Rassom o'zining eksperimental dizaynlari bilan chegaralarni kengaytirishi bilan mashhur.
cards.uzDef: Chegaralarni buzish, yangi narsalarni sinab ko'rish.

cards.ex: The company's been losing money for months; the writing's on the wall.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya bir necha oydan beri pul yo'qotmoqda; oxiri yaqin.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaning muvaffaqiyatsiz bo'lishi aniq, belgilar allaqachon ko'rinib turibdi.

cards.ex: The war was a turning point in the country's history.
cards.exUz: Urush mamlakat tarixida burilish nuqtasi bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Muhim o'zgarish bo'ladigan voqea yoki lahza.

cards.ex: She really rose to the occasion and delivered a fantastic presentation.
cards.exUz: U haqiqatan ham vaziyatga munosib bo'ldi va ajoyib taqdimot qildi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin vaziyatda yaxshi harakat qilish, o'zini ko'rsatish.

cards.ex: It takes a while to learn the ropes when you start a new job.
cards.exUz: Yangi ishni boshlaganingizda, sir-asrorlarni o'rganish biroz vaqt talab etadi.
cards.uzDef: Yangi ish yoki faoliyatning asosiy qoidalarini o'rganish.
